sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach have won seven of their last ten games and currently sit top of the table with 22 points, while Alsager Town are bottom of the division struggling with just four points from ten games. This should be a comfortable home fixture for the in-form leaders.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host Eccleshall in a clash between two strong mid-table sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, welcome Wednesfield Community to what should be a competitive encounter. Bilston Town (5th) face Foley Meir at home, while in-form Barnton host Shawbury United—a fixture between a resurgent Barnton side and struggling Shawbury, who have lost four of their last five. Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills in a bottom-half clash where both teams are searching for consistency. Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town, the division's lowest-ranked team, in a potential opportunity for Brereton to climb away from the mid-table pack. Crewe host Allscott Heath as two struggling sides battle it out, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's poorest performers this season.
